## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the beige circular blade fan and set it on the Navy mat facing the robot

Task description: Move the beige round-blade fan to the navy-blue square mat currently to its right, with the fan face toward the robot.

Success criteria: The fan stands upright near the center of the navy mat, with its base on the mat and circular face toward the robot; both grippers are open and no longer hold it.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the exposed middle section of the support rod below the fan head and above the base, leaving enough room for both pads to contact it. Avoid the blades, thin mesh guard, and support-rod joint.
- Set the gripper opening to fit the support bar width and surrounding clearance. Before closing, confirm that the fingers are on opposite sides of the bar; avoid mistaking a fingertip pressed against the fan cover for having enclosed the support bar.
- When adjusting the orientation, consider lifting the base slightly off the table and leaving room for the fan cover and base to rotate. Watch the potted plant behind it, the cup surface, and the books on the left to avoid contact that could cause it to turn or slide.
- When placing the fan or adjusting its grasp, first ensure the base is supported before releasing. After release, check whether it tilts or is pushed aside by the fingers, avoiding a tip-over from releasing it while suspended.
